name: open-sources

scripts.conformance: npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract feed.read --args '{"url":"https://hnrss.org/frontpage","limit":3}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract hn.top --args '{"limit":3}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract wiki.search --args '{"q":"Hacker News","lang":"en","limit":1}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --contract arxiv.search --args '{"q":"all:agent","limit":2}'

description: CAK 插件：免 key 公开信息源——RSS/Atom/JSON Feed 订阅、Hacker News 榜单、维基百科搜索、arXiv 论文搜索（feed.read / hn.top / wiki.search / arxiv.search）
